profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Systems and Database Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with a decade of experience building large-scale backend and database systems, including client and server protocol and internals work on Apache Cassandra, at Uber, OpenPhone, HBO, and Microsoft. Deep expertise in Go, C#, and TypeScript across distributed, cloud native architectures.

I care about correctness under failure. My favorite problems live inside backend and database systems and their client APIs, work like connection lifecycle handling, data versioning, replication, and consensus, where a small bug can cause an outsized incident. Outside of backend and database internals, I have also led service decomposition efforts, built org-wide reliability metrics, and mentored engineers moving into distributed systems work.

Open to conversations about distributed systems, database internals, and large-scale backend architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Identified structural gaps in an 8 year old internal Cassandra client that had fallen behind the open source project, linking two recurring client issues, poor handling of slow nodes and unstable host tracking, to 7 of 10 major 2025 Cassandra incidents. Used this analysis to win leadership approval for a company wide client modernization program.
* Redesigned the client-server connection lifecycle and host-tracking logic to proactively evict stale, half-open connections, elevating client reliability from 98.9% to 99.999%.
* Authored the core design and planning documents for the client modernization effort and led the decision process on how to host the new client code. Performed regression analysis across 250 plus upstream changes, grouped into intermediate versions to isolate hidden regression and plan a safe rollout order.
* Modernized the Java and Go client libraries with automatic credential management, rolling out authentication enforcement across 400 plus services with zero effort required from service owners.
* Designed and delivered a self serve Cassandra cluster provisioning experience, cutting instance provisioning time from an average of 14 days down to about 1 hour.
positions.insights: Skills: Open Source Development · Software Engineering · Cassandra · Apache Spark · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

* Designed and rolled out service level indicators adopted org wide, creating a data driven baseline for service quality and business guarantees.
* Built automated reporting pipelines for product, sales, and engineering teams, saving 15 hours per month of developer time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Directed a 6 engineer infrastructure modernization effort for Direct Commerce, cutting partner escalations by 28 percent.
* Delivered a purchase platform feature enabling upgrades and downgrades between ad supported and premium plans, increasing subscription revenue by 23 percent in one quarter.
* Led an effort to standardize metrics across the finance and payment system teams, reducing on call load by 34 percent across 40 plus engineers and 3 teams.
* Worked across payments, finance, infrastructure, and customer service teams to deliver OpenAPI tooling and client generation, cutting API incidents and consumption fragmentation by 40 percent.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Led the design and development of an event based monitoring system on a service handling over 1 trillion requests a week, reducing data collection, movement, and transformation costs by 85 percent.
* Migrated services to an automated incident response platform, reducing engineer involvement in incident resolution by 45 percent.
* Created new signals enabling real time analysis, reducing service latency by 45 percent, P90 from roughly 5 seconds to about 10 milliseconds, which improved user retention by 45 percent.
* Migrated the telemetry system to a higher capacity platform, reducing annual costs from approximately 250k to approximately 112k.
* Built a new CI/CD pipeline automating build, test, and compliance checks for the data science pipeline, improving build time by 35 percent and release cycle speed by 70 percent.

positions.description:

* Participated heavily in cross team technical discussions, helping align goals with the broader engineering organization.
* Built a framework allowing multiple cards per provider, increasing usage of some cards by over 23 percent.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

• Created applications which represented real-world applications developed by today's developers, increasing our test coverage from 40% to 87%
• Designed/developed and implemented software and testing suites for NodeJS, Python, MySQL, and PHP, with a portal/dashboard for viewing results, increasing test results usage by over 20%
• Participation in the full software development life cycle from scoping, analysis, design, implementation, and deployment

Summary:
- Molded and formed third-party languages for use on windows nano server
- Documentation of the entire development process
- Worked with two other engineers to develop a test suite for use in-house with the use of deadlines, team meetings, and weekly updates to our superiors

projects.title: Masters Project - Project Grade-Up
projects.description: This Moodle plugin was designed with the intent of allowing students to have access to grade analytic software allowing the visualization of their current progress within a course. Project Grade Up focuses on the students ability to measure their current progress based on visual ques, allowing a quicker understanding of their current plight within the semester. Project Grade Up is a grade graphics plugin for Moodle created by Dalin Williams and Dr. Scot Anderson for the satisfaction of the requirements for Dalin Williams' Masters Degree.
